description: A tenant database (PDB) in an RDS for Oracle container database (CDB) instance that uses the multi-tenant configuration. RDS changes one tenant database of an instance at a time and backs the instance up after each change, so give tenant databases of one instance dependsOn on each other. A deploy waits for the instance after each change, and up to 45 seconds for it to be free before one. Deleting it takes a final DB snapshot of the instance, which Radius never deletes.

SecretStatus.description: The status of the secret, such as active.

KmsKeyId.description: The AWS KMS key that encrypts the secret.

DBInstanceIdentifier.description: The identifier of the CDB instance the tenant database is in. It isn't case-sensitive.

TenantDBName.description: The name of the tenant database. It isn't case-sensitive.

MasterUsername.description: The name of the master user of the tenant database: 1 to 16 letters, numbers, or underscores, starting with a letter.

MasterUserPassword.description: The password of the master user: 8 to 30 printable ASCII characters other than /, ", @, &, and '. Can't be set with ManageMasterUserPassword.

ManageMasterUserPassword.description: Whether RDS manages the master user password in AWS Secrets Manager.

MasterUserSecretKmsKeyId.description: The AWS KMS key that encrypts the secret RDS manages, when ManageMasterUserPassword is true. It can't change once RDS manages the password.

CharacterSetName.description: The character set of the tenant database. AWS uses AL32UTF8 when it isn't set.

NcharCharacterSetName.description: The NCHAR character set of the tenant database. AWS uses AL16UTF16 when it isn't set.

MasterUserSecret.description: The secret RDS manages in AWS Secrets Manager for the master user password.

TenantDatabaseARN.description: The ARN of the tenant database.

TenantDatabaseResourceId.description: The AWS Region-unique, immutable identifier of the tenant database.

DbiResourceId.description: The AWS Region-unique, immutable identifier of the DB instance.

Tags.description: The tags of the tenant database. An RDS resource has at most 50 tags.
